verdict.rationale: The TLD price list endpoint returns an alphabetical list of all TLDs name.com supports, with pricing per order type and three pricing tiers per TLD. That shows a catalog of supported extensions exists and can be browsed per TLD. Nothing in the evidence gives the size of the catalog or documents per-TLD special requirements such as restricted-TLD eligibility or ccTLD rules. Missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of extensions, per-TLD documentation of registration requirements for restricted and country-code TLDs, and independent corroboration of TLD breadth.
